# HaulAgua

> HaulAgua is a directory of bulk water hauling services across the United
> States. Visitors can search verified haulers by city and state for pool
> fills, construction and dust control, potable and drinking water,
> agricultural and livestock water, emergency response, oil and gas, and
> event water delivery. The directory currently covers Texas and Arizona
> with additional states in development.

Use this file to discover all city directory pages and core service
category pages. Each city page lists local bulk water haulers with
phone, website, service categories, and certifications. The directory
is free to search.

## State Directories

- [Texas Bulk Water Haulers](https://www.haulagua.com/water-haulers/tx): Directory of bulk water haulers across Texas cities.
- [Arizona Bulk Water Haulers](https://www.haulagua.com/water-haulers/az): Directory of bulk water haulers across Arizona cities.
